curves.description: Added to the note pitch (after portamento, vibrato and bends); for what the note parameters cannot express.
curves.name: Pitch deviation

curves.description: Formant shift; positive is deeper / more masculine, negative brighter / more feminine.
curves.name: Gender

curves.description: Mix of aperiodic (breath) noise into the voice.
curves.name: Breathiness

curves.description: Spectral tilt; positive is brighter and tenser, negative darker and softer.
curves.name: Brightness

curves.description: Timbre shift independent of pitch, as if the sample were sung higher or lower.
curves.name: Tone

notes.description: Consonant velocity; above 100 shortens the consonant, below lengthens it.
notes.name: Velocity

notes.description: Note intensity.
notes.name: Volume

notes.description: How much of the sample's own pitch wobble is kept.
notes.name: Modulation

notes.description: How early the sample starts before the note; unset uses the oto.ini value.
notes.name: Pre-utterance

notes.description: Crossfade with the previous note; unset uses the oto.ini value.
notes.name: Overlap

notes.description: Extra offset into the sample.
notes.name: Start offset

notes.description: Duration of the glide from the previous note; 0 is a hard step.
notes.name: Portamento length

notes.description: Where the glide starts relative to the note start; negative is before.
notes.name: Portamento start

notes.description: How far the glide goes past the target before settling.
notes.name: Overshoot

notes.description: Dip opposite to the jump just before the glide.
notes.name: Preparation

notes.description: Pitch the note starts at relative to its target; negative is below.
notes.name: Scoop depth

notes.description: Time to bend from the scoop start to the target.
notes.name: Scoop length

notes.description: Pitch reached at the note's end; negative drops.
notes.name: Fall depth

notes.description: Duration of the fall, ending at the note's end.
notes.name: Fall length

notes.description: Share of the note, from its end, that vibrates.
notes.name: Vibrato length

notes.description: One cycle (1000 / rate in Hz); 150..220 is typical.
notes.name: Vibrato period

notes.description: Half the peak-to-peak swing.
notes.name: Vibrato depth

notes.description: Share of the vibrato over which depth grows from 0.
notes.name: Vibrato fade-in

notes.description: Share of the vibrato over which depth shrinks to 0.
notes.name: Vibrato fade-out

notes.description: Starting phase.
notes.name: Vibrato phase

notes.description: Center offset as a share of depth.
notes.name: Vibrato shift

notes.description: Slow random wander of rate and depth, seeded by the note id.
notes.name: Vibrato drift

notes.description: Pitch offset of an extra bend point.
notes.name: Bend point
